name: 52-background-origin
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 17px; } div { margin: 12px 0; padding: 14px; border: 6px dashed #3366cc; font-size: 13px; background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAABAAAAAQCAIAAACQkWg2AAAAIklEQVR4nGM0TjvDQApgIkk1w6gG4gATkergYFQDMYBkDQB2OQGFVVAHNQAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="); background-repeat: no-repeat; background-size: 18px 18px; } .bb { background-origin: border-box; } .pb { background-origin: padding-box; } .cb { background-origin: content-box; }

border-box 起点
